import asyncio
import itertools


async def p01_helper_extra_loop():
    pass


async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        await step(item)
    for item in items:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await audit(item)


async def in_order_steps(steps, *, reason):
    for step in steps:
        await step()
    while steps:
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await audit(steps.pop())


async def p03_member_no_reason(runner, items, db):
    # want: in-order-needs-reason-python
    await runner.in_order(items, db.put)
    # want: in-order-needs-reason-python
    await in_order(items, db.put, reason="")


async def p04_callback_awaited_directly(items, db):
    for item in items:

        async def run(value=item):
            await db.put(value)

        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await run()


async def p05_batch_sibling(items, db):
    for start in range(0, len(items), 10):
        await asyncio.gather(*(db.get(i) for i in items[start : start + 10]))
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await db.audit(start)


async def p06_batch_assign(items, db):
    out = []
    for start in range(0, len(items), 10):
        rows = await asyncio.gather(*(db.get(i) for i in items[start : start + 10]))
        out.extend(rows)


async def p07_return_in_nested(items, db):
    for item in items:

        def keep(other):
            return other != item

        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await db.put(list(filter(keep, items))[0])


async def p08_batched_one(items, db):
    for batch in itertools.batched(items, 1):
        # want: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(db.get(i) for i in batch))
